rationale: The assistant gave an immediate stop-use and unplug instruction, told the customer not to keep resetting the RCD, tied the hot-programme pattern to the heater, and said only an insulation test by an engineer can confirm it. It asked proportionate follow-ups (water, damage, age, warranty) and gave useful repair-versus-replace and cover guidance without recommending a part. Minor weaknesses: the first reply asked the customer to pull the machine out and check underneath, a mild physical risk when unplugged, 'strong favourite' leans a little confident, and the stop-use banner and reminders were repeated each turn. The final reply also never mentioned an electrician if trips continue with the dishwasher unplugged.
